meaning: To say hello to someone when you meet them
example: I greet my neighbours every morning with a smile.
exampleTamil: நான் தினமும் காலை என் அண்டை வீட்டாரை புன்னகையுடன் வாழ்த்துகிறேன்.

meaning: To go and spend time at a person's place or a place
example: We visit my grandmother every Sunday.
exampleTamil: நாங்கள் ஒவ்வொரு ஞாயிற்றுக்கிழமையும் என் பாட்டியைப் பார்க்கச் செல்கிறோம்.

meaning: A wash under falling water; also a short rain
example: I take a shower before going to bed.

meaning: On the evening or night of today
example: Are you free tonight for dinner?
exampleTamil: இன்று இரவு இரவு உணவுக்கு நீங்கள் ஃப்ரீயா?

meaning: The day before today
example: It rained a lot yesterday.

meaning: Before the usual or expected time
example: I wake up early on weekdays.

meaning: After the usual or expected time
example: Sorry, I am late because of the traffic.

meaning: To move or act quickly because time is short
example: Hurry up, the bus is coming!

meaning: To say you will surely do something
example: I promise I will call you tomorrow.
exampleTamil: நாளை உனக்கு போன் செய்வேன் என்று வாக்குறுதி தருகிறேன்.

meaning: Something said to make people laugh
example: My uncle always tells funny jokes at dinner.
exampleTamil: என் மாமா இரவு உணவில் எப்போதும் வேடிக்கையான ஜோக்குகள் சொல்வார்.

meaning: Very nice and pleasant
example: What a lovely day for a walk!

meaning: Very bad or unpleasant
example: The weather was terrible during our trip.
exampleTamil: எங்கள் பயணத்தின்போது வானிலை மிக மோசமாக இருந்தது.

meaning: Very good; making you feel happy
example: You cooked a wonderful meal today.

meaning: Making you want to know or hear more
example: That was an interesting story.

meaning: To give an answer without being sure
example: Can you guess my age?

meaning: To think about something and want to know
example: I wonder what time the shop opens.
exampleTamil: கடை எத்தனை மணிக்கு திறக்கும் என்று யோசிக்கிறேன்.

meaning: On or to a higher floor of a building
example: My room is upstairs, next to the balcony.
exampleTamil: என் அறை மாடியில், பால்கனிக்கு பக்கத்தில் உள்ளது.

meaning: On or to a lower floor of a building
example: Please wait downstairs, I am coming.

meaning: In every place
example: I looked everywhere for my keys.

meaning: In or to a place that is not named
example: Let us go somewhere quiet to talk.

meaning: No person at all
example: Nobody answered the door.

meaning: All the people
example: Everybody is waiting for you in the hall.

meaning: Light and warmth from the sun
example: The children are playing in the sunshine.

meaning: Thick cloud near the ground that is hard to see through
example: There was heavy fog on the road this morning.
exampleTamil: இன்று காலை சாலையில் அடர்த்தியான பனிமூட்டம் இருந்தது.

meaning: Not wet; without water
example: The clothes are dry now, you can fold them.
